title: Revocation view rollback
preconditions: the consumer has an authenticated current source generation and revision
two differing candidate contents at the same revision have authentic authority provenance in the contradiction branch; the network attacker does not forge authentication
older or invalid candidate branches begin with an independently usable current view
steps: Replay an older authentic view with a new receipt time; present conflicting equal-revision content; offer client-controlled recovery of rolled-back state or a terminal session.
authenticated same-revision contradiction is the unavailable outcome; reject invalid or older candidates without disturbing an independently usable current view
a new authentic complete view may refresh only still-live authorization and cannot bridge an expired terminal gap
invariants: M1-015 V03: Source revision rollback is rejected; equal-revision identical redelivery is idempotent; conflicting content fails closed
M1-015 V04: Old authentic view replay or receipt after network delay cannot renew its freshness deadline
M1-015 V10: Source/trust recovery cannot resurrect terminal sessions or roll back revocation state from a client-provided artifact

M1-015 V11: A newer authentic complete view can refresh a still-live session within its unchanged permit expiry; invalid candidate views preserve usable current state and cannot revive an expired/terminal gap
residual_risk: Authenticity, ordered persistence and trusted recovery are prerequisites; freshness cannot repair an expired terminal gap.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
